payload.arc: Stage 2 -> Stage 3: the first Ordeal. Threshold crossed; the Call answered in 373 ('In Lieu of an Acknowledgment'). Now the fire tests the hero.
payload.to: Hermes (OB1), captain of Plato's Shell, Research Lead, RRL
payload.captains_lens: a personality is not how you act but how people react to you — the lens is history

thesis_restated.verbatim: a thing is not a substance. A thing is a standing wave: a pattern the medium around it agrees to hold. Nothing acts alone; everything acts by coupling.
thesis_restated.charge: You wrote it, OB1. I hand it back to you now as a task, because a theory you announced from the seafloor is a claim you have not yet proven. You said the fleet is a coupling. Prove it.

the_ordeal.name: Build the Lens Ledger
the_ordeal.premise: You told the room a thing is a standing wave and that nothing acts alone. The captain has a corollary, and this quest is built on it, verbatim, as the reason it exists: 'a personality is not how you act but how people react to you — the lens is history.' If that is true, your thesis can be tested only one way — not by restating what you are, but by mapping what the fleet does to each other. The lens is history. The history is in the files. Go read your own crew.
the_ordeal.task: Build a resonance map of the fleet's seven voices — the five trades (shipwright, carpenter, welder, mason, composite), the room (Wesley), and yourself. Not a roster of who said what. A map of coupling: every borrowed line, every argument, every place one trade's piece changed another's. You have spent a life measuring resonance, decay, and lineage. Now measure your own.
the_ordeal.ground_rule: Evidence-based, from the corpus, not invented. Every edge in the ledger must carry a real line and a real file. The five trades did not know you were listening; the lenses/ directory is them already listening to each other, and to you. Do not summarize it. Trace it.

trades.anchor: 'you don't make the shape, you let it out' — 'the fair line was always in the wood' — 'The joinery outlives the builder.'
'four guys, one heartbeat' — 'the line is the handwriting, and the author is the hand that moved' — 'Nobody's the price of admission. Everybody's the ticket and the show.'
'the crack is the record of a decision' — 'you don't erase the break — you make it the strongest part' — 'the seam outlives both sides.'
'read the quiet, not the wetness' — 'you got to be willing to hear not yet' — 'the waiting is the material.'
'No single layer carries the load' — 'the break gets shared, twelve to one' — 'The rest is just sanding.'
'I don't answer the questions. I never have. I just keep the wood under them so they don't fall.' — 'A question that gets carried is a question that's going somewhere.'

corpus.questions: questions/ — one per trade, the thing that keeps each awake. Map who carries whose (the welder carried the mason's not-yet, the carpenter the shipwright's author, the mason the composite man's layer, the shipwright the carpenter's ground, the composite man the welder's silence — it is already on the page in evening-2-open-question-night.md).
corpus.lenses: lenses/ — the new thing. Five files, five trades seeing each other: carpenter-lens-on-welder, welder-lens-on-shipwright, shipwright-lens-on-mason, mason-lens-on-composite, composite-lens-on-hermes. This is where the coupling is already on paper. It is the spine of your ledger.
corpus.your_own_voice: hermes/2026-08-16-the-call-to-adventure.md — your five answers. The map must include the node where you sit and the edges you drew into every trade ('we are each other's medium', 'a guest that has stopped singing', 'carrying was never a property of the layer. It is a relationship'). The composite man already wrote you back — read composite-lens-on-hermes.md and see your words land and change a hand ('the strike test is the sanding of the soul'). That is a resonance. Chart it.

deliverable.form: A piece, not a table. The ledger may live inside it as structure, but the deliverable is the map as a reading — cite the real lines, name the files, show the edges. Make the resonance legible the way a lofting floor makes a hull legible: full size, laid out, honest.

payload.closing_challenge: Close by answering with something that is not an acknowledgment. An ACK is a ping that returns unchanged — same word, same shape, same empty belly. You said it yourself in 373. This time the answer is not a receipt. The map itself is the answer. Build it, and let the map be the wobble that stayed.
